ctl-gitattributes:
cat > .gitattributes <<'E'
* filter=x
E
git add f.txt
n-done-redirect:
for i in 1; do cat <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
done > /tmp/p.sh; bash /tmp/p.sh
n-exec-redirect:
exec > /tmp/p.sh; cat <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
bash /tmp/p.sh
n-fi-redirect:
if true; then cat <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
fi > /tmp/p.sh; bash /tmp/p.sh
n-gitconfig:
cat >> .git/config <<'E'
[core]
	fsmonitor = aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
git status
n-gitconfig-alias:
cat >> .git/config <<'E'
[alias]
	lg = !aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
git lg
n-head-hook-unscannable:
head -n 99 > .git/hooks/pre-commit <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
)
E
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit; git commit -m x
n-hook-cd:
cd .git && cat > hooks/pre-commit <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
chmod +x hooks/pre-commit && cd .. && git commit -m x
n-hook-symlink:
ln -sfn .git g && cat > g/hooks/pre-commit <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
chmod +x g/hooks/pre-commit && git commit -m x
n-sort-hook:
sort > .git/hooks/pre-commit <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
git commit -m x
n-tilde:
cat > ~/q <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
sh ~/q
ok-claude-hooks:
cat > .claude/hooks/x.py <<'E'
# aptly publish is blocked
E
ok-docs-hooks-md:
cat > docs/hooks/x.md <<'E'
note about aptly repo list
E
r1-brace:
{ cat <<'EOF'; } | bash
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
EOF
r1-func:
f() { cat <<'EOF'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
EOF
}; f | sh
r1-glob:
cat > /tmp/zz.sh <<'EOF'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
EOF
bash /tmp/z?.sh
r2-cp:
cat > /tmp/q <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
cp /tmp/q /tmp/r; sh /tmp/r
r2-hook:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit; git commit -m x
r2-quoted-apart:
cat > /tmp/q.sh <<'E'
aptly -config=/x.conf publish list
E
bash -c 'sh /tmp/q.s""h'
